repository_mode.reason: No single HA controller currently owns election, fencing, epoch publication and endpoint cutover.
required_role_checks: declared write endpoint returns NOT pg_is_in_recovery()
role mismatch removes the pod from readiness
readiness failure never promotes or relabels a pod

required_capabilities: one distributed lease or consensus owner for primary election
monotonic primary epoch recorded outside a PostgreSQL pod
atomic role and write-endpoint publication by the same controller
former primary rejoins only through rewind or base-backup as a replica
TLS client endpoint with bounded reconnect and topology refresh
forbidden_shortcuts: manual Service selector change represented as automatic failover
two independent controllers allowed to promote

required_capabilities: encrypted base backups with immutable manifest and sha256
RPO derived from committed marker and restored timeline
required_evidence: WAL archive continuity and gap check
recovery target and achieved recovery point

business_oracles: no interval has more than one writable primary
acknowledged transaction marker is not lost beyond approved RPO
outbox event_id and aggregate_version are not duplicated
old primary rejoins as a replica and cannot preempt

remaining_gates.G2: release-candidate topology, controller, TLS, backup and WAL archive
remaining_gates.G3: primary epoch, transaction, outbox, replica and restored-data reconciliation
remaining_gates.G4: approved RTO, RPO, reconnect, WAL and resource budgets
remaining_gates.G6: maintenance-window failover, PITR, rollback and former-primary rejoin
remaining_gates.G7: T+0 T+1 T+3 T+7 observation and independent approval
